vt1019001.title: SONY TCM-450 V.O.R. Cassette-Corder Portable Cassette Tape Recorder Working
vt1019001.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vt1019001.details: Sony TCM-450 portable cassette-corder with V.O.R. (voice-operated recording). Condition per the seller: scuffs and wear from use and a dent in the lid, as shown in the photos. The seller replaced the drive belt and the tape counter belt, and confirmed that record, play, fast forward, rewind, cue, review, playback speed control, the double recording time mode and VOR all work. Included: the recorder only. No batteries, catalog or cassette tape is included.
vt1019001.why: A used Sony TCM-450 portable cassette recorder with replaced belts.
vt1019001.perfect: Collectors of vintage Sony recorders and people who still use cassette tapes.
vt1019001.exp: A pre-owned Sony TCM-450 cassette recorder in the condition described above.
